projects.name: specsage
projects.description: Agentic RAG over the IETF RFC archive. Answers stream in with inline citations that resolve to exact RFC sections, and a committed, re-runnable evaluation harness measures per-stage retrieval, citation validity, groundedness, and refusal accuracy on out-of-scope questions rather than asserting them.

projects.name: AI-Augmented SOC
projects.description: Research-grade AI security operations center combining intrusion-detection models trained on CICIDS2017, local LLM alert triage, retrieval over security knowledge, Wazuh integration, incident correlation, attack-campaign simulation, and a prototype response planner.

projects.name: driftguard
projects.description: An end-to-end ML lifecycle that watches itself: train, track and register with MLflow, serve through FastAPI, detect drift, auto-retrain. Demonstrated on a real distribution shift and evaluated on held-out data, where retraining cut held-out MAE from 87.3 to 48.4.

projects.name: ContextForge
projects.description: A self-hostable documentation answer bot you can point at your own markdown, PDFs, or a URL. Every answer is grounded in and cites its sources, and the service explicitly abstains when retrieval confidence is too low to trust the answer.

projects.name: sentinel-triage
projects.description: Alert triage that cuts mean-time-to-triage without teaching the SOC to cry wolf. Endpoint and auth events are correlated into candidate incidents, then matched against Sigma detection rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK so analysts see one real incident instead of thousands of low-fidelity alerts.

projects.name: agentops-sentinel
projects.description: A supervisor and self-critique agent framework for support-ticket triage. A planner routes work to specialized tool-using sub-agents, a critique loop retries or escalates failed steps, and every decision is traced end to end under a hard cost budget so runs stay reliable and observable.

projects.name: driftguard-llm
projects.description: A RAG service with a monitoring plane bolted onto its hot path: every query embedding feeds a statistical drift detector and a rolling sample of responses is scored, so silent retrieval and answer-quality regressions surface with a timestamp instead of accumulating until a customer complains.

projects.name: advanced-rag-llm-app
projects.description: A self-contained advanced AI application combining retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, document ingestion, prompt orchestration, and LLM APIs, built to answer questions from a controlled knowledge base while exposing the engineering tradeoffs behind retrieval quality, latency, grounding, and evaluation.

projects.name: MLOps Workflow
projects.description: A full-stack MLOps deployment on Google Cloud: BigQuery as the data layer, Terraform-provisioned infrastructure, containerized training and serving, and GitHub Actions CI/CD wiring the pipeline from raw data through to a deployed model.

projects.name: modelcard
projects.description: Turns a trained scikit-learn estimator into a deterministic Markdown model card — intended use, training data, metrics, limitations, and feature importances — derived from the artifact itself so governance documentation is regenerated in one command and is byte-identical given identical inputs, safe to diff in CI.

projects.name: AI Multilingual Tutor-Bot
projects.description: A multilingual AI language tutor built with GPT, MarianMT, DistilBERT and RoBERTa, supporting translation, autocomplete, sentiment and emotion analysis. NLP performance was benchmarked on 3,000 French sentences using SequenceMatcher, reaching an 87.29% similarity score while optimizing inference efficiency.

projects.name: ESP32 Biometric Login System
projects.description: A secure facial-recognition login system pairing an ESP32-CAM running an Edge Impulse model with a Flask backend, authenticating in real time over Socket.IO. JWT-based session management with automated token cleanup and multi-step verification strengthens authentication between the embedded hardware and the web application.

projects.name: Wells Fargo JPA Financial Model
projects.description: A Java backend service using Spring Data JPA and Hibernate to model complex financial relationships. It implements a hierarchical data structure of advisors, clients, portfolios, and securities, holding data integrity through relational mapping, custom constraints, and modern Java Time APIs.
